Real visible paper thickness, raised stacked cutouts, curled folds, embossed fibers, matte rag paper, translucent mulberry tissue and restrained antique gold leaf. Precise deep CONTACT SHADOWS BETWEEN layers, tiny irregularities of hand cutting, dimensional sculptural faces and exposed paper-fastener joints for puppets. Warm raking theatrical side spotlight with cool fill. Not flat vector art, not smooth plastic, not an ordinary comic drawing. Card role: Boss; the rank is only a visual archetype, do not show letters or numbers. Clear big forms readable at 64px, rich selective craftsmanship at 160–300px, one visual focal point. A narrow opaque warm ivory die-cut edge tightly follows the irregular silhouette, subtle tight edge shadow. No rectangular background, floor plane, scenery extending to the edge, display plinth unrelated to the subject, card bitmap, indices, suit symbols, lettering, numerals, signs, logos or watermark.
